overview_description.description:
Radley designs and manufactures handbags, purses and other women’s accessories for UK and international markets.

Radley currently has 33 stores and eight concessions in key UK cities and retail centers, alongside a presence in 33 John Lewis stores, 58 branches of House of Fraser and more than 200 other department stores and independent shops nationwide.

about_short_description.short_description: Radley designs and manufactures handbags, purses and other women’s accessories for UK and international markets.

product.name: Leather Handbags
product.description: Leather handbags designed for carrying personal items, available in various styles such as shoulder bags, cross body bags, grab bags, and totes.

product.name: Purses
product.description: Small leather purses designed to hold cards, coins, and cash, featuring compartments and zip closures.

product.name: Cross Body Bags
product.description: Leather cross body bags with adjustable straps for hands-free carrying of personal items.

product.name: Shoulder Bags
product.description: Leather shoulder bags with padded or smooth straps, designed for carrying personal belongings over the shoulder.

product.name: Grab Bags
product.description: Handheld grab bags made from leather or woven materials, designed for carrying essentials by hand or with a detachable strap.

product.name: Tote Bags
product.description: Large open-top tote bags made from leather, designed for carrying multiple items and everyday essentials.
